{{Quote|Could be skronkies. They make a pretty annoying noise.|[[Drend Navett]]|<ref name="Vision of the Future">''[[Vision of the Future]]''</ref>}}
'''Skronkies''' were tiny insects that did not respond to normal extermination methods. They had been known to make a loud humming sound at seemingly random intervals.<ref name="Vision of the Future" />

Skronkies were very similar to [[aphren]]s and [[metalmite]]s.<ref name="Vision of the Future" />
